title: Por la noche
blurbEn: The end of Ana's day, and two more reflexive verbs that Spanish uses where English would not.
body:
Por la noche ceno con mi familia. Normalmente cenamos a las nueve.

Después vemos la televisión o leo un libro.

Me acuesto a las once y me duermo pronto.

Duermo ocho horas cada noche.
translationEn:
At night I have dinner with my family. We usually have dinner at nine.

Afterwards we watch television or I read a book.

I go to bed at eleven and I fall asleep quickly.

I sleep eight hours every night.

duermo.note: Compare 'me duermo' (I fall asleep) with 'duermo' (I sleep). The 'me' changes the meaning.
